data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure, site order and most parameters right, but misses key details: picking the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more, noting prices and the evening time, the 'do not reserve/book' limits, and the exact note, subject and body templates; it also uses vague or duplicated parameters ('dates', and separate travelers and party size), so an automation built from it would be underspecified.
